summary: Enhabit, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing that stockholder lawsuits were filed challenging the merger under which Anchor Parent, LLC (affiliated with Kinderhook Industries) will acquire Enhabit via a merger with Merger Sub, with Enhabit surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary. The definitive proxy statement was filed April 14, 2026, seeking stockholder approval at a special meeting scheduled for May 12, 2026. Three complaints allege misrepresentations/omissions in the proxy statement regarding financial projections, Goldman Sachs' fairness opinion inputs, conflicts, and the merger background. No price/share, premium, or break fee stated. What to watch: court rulings on disclosure claims and stockholder vote outcome.
